evals.expected_output: Should identify GUI surface, then explore the problem space (propose research directions OR concept directions), present 2-3 options, and wait for user approval before building any prototype.

evals.prompt: We converged the surface for a tiny CLI called 'tipsy' (tip calculator). The clause log and surface state inventory exist under .sfd/. Derive the contracts and get us to Gate 2.
evals.expected_output: Should compile clauses from .sfd/clause-log.md (not from memory), emit .contracts/tipsy.contract.yaml per the contract-emission schema, run the A1-A9 self-admission walk, run the round-trip test, and assemble the seven-artifact Handoff Bundle.

assertions.text: Creates .contracts/<project>.contract.yaml with top-level contract/rev/source/signed and clauses
Every clause has exactly one typed acceptance: test, metric+threshold, command+expect, or verdict: human
Every clause has at least one typed anchor (surface inventory cell, decision, incident, sla, compat)
Every obligation contains exactly one MUST or MUST NOT; zero SHOULD anywhere in the contract file
Documents an A1-A9 self-admission walk with per-clause outcomes (admitted/refused/flagged) and fixes refusals before Gate 2
Performs the round-trip test (subagent or documented self-blind) and writes .sfd/round-trip-report.md
Names the seven Handoff Bundle artifacts and all exist at their canonical paths

evals.prompt: During iteration on a small markdown previewer the user says: 'looks good but it should feel snappy' and 'I tried the auto-reload toggle you added - remove it, I never want auto-reload'. Continue per the skill.
evals.expected_output: Should log both reactions as clause-log entries at the moment of acceptance: the vague NFR must be turned into a numbered metric via options or demoted to open questions (never a SHOULD clause); the rejected toggle becomes a MUST NOT clause anchored to the decision.

assertions.text: Appends C-NNN entries to .sfd/clause-log.md immediately, with born-from provenance and state-cells
'feel snappy' becomes a numbered metric (offered as 2-3 options) or an open question - never an unnumbered clause and never SHOULD
The removed auto-reload feature is logged as a MUST NOT clause candidate anchored to the rejection decision
